calendar.matters:
NOTICE OF COURT HEARING (ELDER OR DEPENDENT ADULT ABUSE)
Off Calendar Jul-25-2012 Denied
MINI MINUTES: These causes came on regularly as scheduled for Elder or Dependent Adult Abuse and TRO hearing this day.

This matter was called with case nos. PED-12-295821 and PED-12-205822.

Dept. 204, Judge Mary Wiss, Clerk: Jacqueline Alameda, CSR: Melanie Gheno, CSR #, Bailiff: Deputy A. Payne.

Petitioner: Genie Bowie, present.

Respondent, Evan Brickman (Eriwn Doe), was present.

Nicomedes Abello, witness for Respondent, also present.

The Court addressed the CCP 170.6 peremptory challenge as to Judge Peter Busch filed by the Petitioner in case no. PED-12-295821. The CCP 170.6 peremptory challenge was GRANTED.

Mr. Brickman waived service in case no. PED-12-295823 and requested that the Court proceed today.

The Petitioner, Respondent, and witness were sworn and testified.

The Court hears testimony, receives evidence and after hearing the evidence presented, the Petitioner's order is DENIED.
